تنتشلين (form VIII)
# تَنْتَشِلِينَ (tantašilīna) /tan.ta.ʃi.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَشَلَ (intašala)
# تُنْتَشَلِينَ (tuntašalīna) /tun.ta.ʃa.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَشَلَ (intašala)
